summary: The weekly report shows what moved, not only counts. profile_insights.weekly() now also returns, per library direction (a paper in two categories counts in both), this week's and last week's explicit records with a neutral status (new / more / same / fewer / quiet = no record at all this week / other), the papers behind each direction; the seven days of the week by kind; this week's saved or understood papers with their direction and learning unit; the learning map's progress and which units got an 'understood' this week (saving alone does not advance a unit); and exposure shown as 'seen', never as turned down. The page (weekly_report.html + new weekly-ui.js, profile.css .wk-*) draws a headline, five number tiles, a day chart, direction cards with last-week/this-week bars, a learning-map section, picks and term changes. The old PDHProfile.weeklyHTML table is removed. Everything is a count of the person's own local records; no model call, no network.

budget_impact.rationale: Local, deterministic counts over the person's own records; no model call, no network, nothing stored. The route is read through the existing route_get only for the weekly report, and its paper matching covers only the papers that had a record this week.
budget_impact.before: a counts table and single-word term changes
budget_impact.after: direction-level changes, a day chart, learning-map progress and picks
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: browser preview on a seeded copy
additional_checks.scope: weekly_report.html drawn with real data (directions, day chart, learning-map section, picks); the profile page still opens and links to it
PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt, contains weekly-ui.js; not launched

reviews.reviewer: One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); 1 critical and 5 important defects found and fixed; the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: The independent review's fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
Directions are the shared library categories; a paper in no category is shown as 未分类, and a project whose papers were never filed gets one big 未分类 card.
Matching a paper to a learning unit uses the same search-term match as the learning map (derived, not stored); a paper that fits no unit is not counted in any unit.
The English wording avoids plurals by using 'Papers this week: N' style lines; only checked by reading.
The /api/weekly_report/analysis text summary was not changed and still only mentions the old counts.
The Tauri window was not clicked through.
